lead.question: 乔治用五十便士买了什么让他陷入麻烦的东西？最后他又得到了什么？
lead.warmup: 先回想自己的存钱经历：爸爸妈妈给的零花钱，你是一分一分攒进储蓄罐，还是转身就跑去了糖果店花个精光？课文里的男孩乔治也有个储蓄罐，却总是空空如也。叔叔给他五十便士，本想让他存起来，他反过来给自己买了一场麻烦。读课文时留意：钱是怎么从他手里溜走的，最后又是谁赏了他一份甜头。
goals: 掌握 pocket money、money box、thrifty、sweet shop 等与零花钱、糖果相关的词汇。
理解 go a long way、find one's way、what is more、exchange...for... 等固定表达。
辨析 fifty pence pieces 与 fifty pennies 的用法差异。
体会一般过去时叙述事件与现在完成时总结经历的搭配。
lead.summary: 课文先谈孩子对零花钱的态度：少量钱也能花很久，只有特别节俭的孩子才装得满储蓄罐。接着讲外甥乔治：他有个空储蓄罐，叔叔给的钱大多没存进去。昨天他拿五十便士去糖果店，硬币掉进阴沟，他伸手去掏，胳膊反被阴沟盖卡住，消防队用特殊润滑剂才把他救出。糖果店老板娘听说后，赏了他一大盒巧克力。
lead.tips: fifty pence pieces 指若干枚五十便士的硬币，复数仍用 pence；fifty pennies 则是五十枚一便士硬币，两者别混淆。

questions.q: Did George get anything for his fifty pence? What?
questions.zh: 乔治的五十便士换来了什么吗？换来了什么？
questions.a: Yes, he did. He did not get the sweets he wanted, but he ended up with a large box of chocolates from the owner of the sweet shop.
questions.aZh: 换来了。他没买成想要的糖，却从糖果店老板娘那里得到了一大盒巧克力。
questions.hint: 答案见课文最后一句：the lady who owns the sweet shop ... rewarded him with large box of chocolates.

questions.q: What do most children do with fifty pence, and what kind of children manage to fill up a money box?
questions.zh: 大部分孩子拿五十便士做什么？什么样的孩子才能把储蓄罐装满？
questions.a: For most of them, fifty pence is a small price to pay for a nice big bar of chocolate. Only very thrifty children manage to fill up a money box.
questions.aZh: 对大部分孩子来说，五十便士买一大块好巧克力算不了什么；只有特别节俭的孩子才能把储蓄罐装满。

questions.q: What happened to George's fifty pence on his way to the sweet shop?
questions.zh: 乔治去糖果店的路上，那五十便士怎么了？
questions.a: He dropped it, and it bounced along the pavement and then disappeared down a drain.
questions.aZh: 他把钱掉了，硬币在人行道上弹跳了几下，然后掉进了阴沟里。
questions.hint: 见课文第10句 On his way to the sweet shop...

questions.q: How was George finally freed from the drain cover?
questions.zh: 乔治最后是怎么从阴沟盖里脱身的？
questions.a: The fire brigade was called and two fire fighters freed him using a special type of grease.
questions.aZh: 有人叫来了消防队，两名消防员用一种特殊的润滑剂才使他脱身。

questions.q: Why was George not too upset by his experience?
questions.zh: 为什么乔治对这次经历并不太难过？
questions.a: Because the lady who owned the sweet shop heard about his troubles and rewarded him with a large box of chocolates, so he got something sweet out of it.
questions.aZh: 因为糖果店老板娘听说了他的遭遇后，赏了他一大盒巧克力，所以他反倒得了甜头。
questions.hint: 见课文最后一句的 because 从句。

exercises.q: 汉译英：爸爸妈妈当然经常给孩子零花钱。
exercises.a: Mum or dad, of course, provide a regular supply of pocket money.

exercises.q: 汉译英：对于有些孩子来说，少量的钱可以花很长一段时间。
exercises.a: With some children, small sums go a long way.
exercises.note: go a long way 可以维持很久

exercises.q: 填空：If fifty pence pieces are not ______ for sweets, they rattle for months inside money boxes.
句型转换：用 what is more 把 "He could not find his fifty pence piece anywhere. He could not get his arm out." 合并为一句。
exercises.a: He could not find his fifty pence piece anywhere, and what is more, he could not get his arm out.
exercises.note: what is more 更有甚者

exercises.q: 改错：Very few of the fifty pence pieces and pound coins I gave him have found their way there.
exercises.a: Very few of the fifty pence pieces and pound coins I have given him have found their way there.
exercises.note: give 用现在完成时 have given

exercises.q: 填空并辨析：a fifty ______ piece 指一枚五十便士硬币，而 fifty ______ 指五十枚一便士硬币。
exercises.note: pence 与 pennies 的区别

exercises.q: 汉译英：昨天我给了他五十便士，并建议他把它存起来。
exercises.a: I gave him fifty pence yesterday and advised him to save it.
exercises.note: advise sb. to do 建议某人做某事

quiz.q: 课文开头说，孩子们总是喜欢什么？
options: small gifts of money
big boxes of chocolates
new money boxes
regular supplies of sweets
quiz.note: Children always appreciate small gifts of money.

quiz.q: 在课文中，除了父母，谁还是孩子额外收入的来源？
options: Teachers and friends
Uncles and aunts
Brothers and sisters
Neighbours and strangers
quiz.note: uncles and aunts are always a source of extra income

quiz.q: "small sums go a long way" 在文中是什么意思？
options: Small sums last a long time.
Small sums are quickly spent.
Small sums are hard to save.
Small sums are worth little.
quiz.note: go a long way = 可以维持很久

quiz.q: 乔治的储蓄罐为什么总是空空的？
options: He has no money box at all.
He gives his money to his friends.
Very few of the coins he is given find their way there.
He lost his money box down a drain.
quiz.note: 大多数硬币没能存进储蓄罐

quiz.q: 乔治的五十便士掉进阴沟后，他的胳膊怎么了？
options: He hurt it badly on the pavement.
He could not get it out of the drain cover.
He burned it on the hot pavement.
He dropped it into the money box.
quiz.note: he could not get his arm out

quiz.q: 谁最后让乔治摆脱了困境？
options: A lady with soap and butter
The owner of the sweet shop
Two fire fighters with a special grease
A crowd of people who gathered round him
quiz.note: two fire fighters freed George using a special type of grease
